title: Off the Dock
lines: Josh and Nick fish off the dock with Dad.
Josh gets a big fish. Nick gets a shell.
Then Nick tugs up a wet sock!
"That is not a fish," said Nick.
"Wish, and do not let go," said Dad.
Josh sits with him, and then his rod dips.
He tugs and tugs, and up it hops!
"Such luck!" said Josh. "That fish is big."

questions.ask: What does Nick pull up before he gets a fish?
questions.listenFor: A shell and a wet sock. Two things - if they name only one, ask "and what else?"

questions.ask: What does Dad tell Nick to do?
questions.listenFor: Wish, and do not let go. It is the line in quote marks - have them find the talking.

questions.ask: Was Josh a good friend to Nick? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. You are listening for a reason from the story, like "yes, he sat with him and told him to keep going."
